metadata.name: fmt2-kolla-deploy-sequence
metadata.description: Run the ordered Kolla-Ansible deploy sequence from the FMT2 Rocky 10 deployer VM after node-prep and render gates pass.

variables.name: kolla_config_dir
variables.description: Kolla configuration directory containing globals.yml, passwords.yml, multinode, and generated admin-openrc.sh.

variables.name: kolla_inventory
variables.description: Kolla-Ansible multinode inventory rendered by render-fmt2-kolla-config.yml.

variables.name: smoke_image
variables.description: Tiny image name used by first-pass Nova smoke.

stages.summary: Generate Kolla passwords on the deployer; never commit /etc/kolla/passwords.yml as plaintext.
Bootstrap Kolla host dependencies through Kolla-Ansible before any OpenStack service deploy.
Run Kolla prechecks; If prechecks fail, stop and capture the exact failed check in the issue and E2ET evidence instead of bypassing it.
Validate rendered Kolla configuration before deploy.
Deploy first-pass Kolla OpenStack services after bootstrap, prechecks, and validate-config pass.
Run Kolla post-deploy to generate admin-openrc.sh and finish API client setup.
Run first-pass OpenStack API smoke after post-deploy.
command: source /etc/kolla/admin-openrc.sh && openstack endpoint list && openstack service list && openstack hypervisor list && openstack network agent list

stages.summary: Create a tiny tenant network and instance; if it fails, capture Nova, Neutron, libvirt, and Podman logs.
command: source /etc/kolla/admin-openrc.sh && openstack flavor create --ram 512 --disk 1 --vcpus 1 rfc1918.smoke.tiny && openstack network create rfc1918-smoke-net && openstack subnet create --network rfc1918-smoke-net --subnet-range 192.0.2.0/24 rfc1918-smoke-subnet && openstack server create --flavor rfc1918.smoke.tiny --image cirros --network rfc1918-smoke-net rfc1918-smoke-001 && openstack server show rfc1918-smoke-001
